label: run_03_local_validation
_comment: Small three-level study for validating the whole pipeline on a laptop/WSL in minutes. Not a physics result. Energy guard: kinetic energy cannot grow in this closed unforced domain, so a rise above 1% of its running minimum stops the level and marks the reliable horizon. Expect levels to stop before T rather than reach it -- that is the intended behaviour, and it bounds the cost automatically.
